description.en-US: Personal F-Droid repository with custom apps: Pluralis (alternative news aggregator) and OpenLibe Extended (e-ink library client).

Sobre is an anti-brainrot audio player for YouTube subscriptions.
It plays only the audio from channels you explicitly follow —
no video, no thumbnails, no algorithmic recommendations, no Shorts,
no comments, no infinite scroll.

The interface is 100% text: no images, no icons, no avatars.
Subscribe by pasting a channel or video URL, or by sharing directly
from the YouTube app.

Features:
* Audio-only playback with background and lock screen support
* Subscribe to channels via URL paste or Android share intent
* Chronological feed — no algorithm, no recommendations
* Episode chapters and full descriptions
* Adjustable playback speed (0.75x to 2x)
* Download episodes for offline listening
* Periodic RSS-based feed refresh
* High-contrast text UI, e-ink friendly
* Fully local, no accounts, no tracking

Built with NewPipeExtractor (GPLv3). Not affiliated with YouTube.

summary.en-US: App de livres audio pour e-bibliomedia Lausanne

description.en-US:
Application de livres audio pour la Bibliothèque Sonore Romande
via e-bibliomedia. Streaming et téléchargement, gestion des prêts
et réservations.

summary.en-US: Dictionnaire Littré complet, gratuit et hors-ligne

description.en-US:
Le dictionnaire de la langue fran\xE7aise d'\xC9mile Littr\xE9,
complet et enti\xE8rement gratuit, consultable hors-ligne.
78 599 entr\xE9es avec d\xE9finitions, \xE9tymologies et citations.
Recherche instantan\xE9e, mot du jour, favoris, renvois crois\xE9s
cliquables, mode sombre. Aucune connexion internet requise.
Donn\xE9es lexicographiques sous licence CC BY-SA 3.0
(Fran\xE7ois Gannaz, littre.org).

A calming, distraction-free breathing exercise app. Follow the
animated guide around a square: breathe in, hold, breathe out, hold.
The 4-minute session starts with a 3-second rhythm and gently
transitions to 4 seconds halfway through. Bilingual instructions
(English / French). No accounts, no ads, no tracking.

summary.en-US: Unofficial espresso timer for the 9Barista stovetop machine. 3 taps only.

description.en-US:
A minimal espresso timer designed for the 9Barista double-boiler stovetop
espresso machine. Unofficial and fan-made — not affiliated with or endorsed
by 9Barista Ltd.

Three taps per brew:
1. Tap to start heating (counts up, warns at 8 minutes)
2. Tap when espresso appears — starts extraction timer with circular
   progress ring, turns green in the 25–30 second target zone
3. Tap when done — shows results and grind adjustment advice

Haptic feedback at 25s (target zone), 30s (over target), and 8 min
(max heating). Screen stays on during brewing.

Timings based on official 9Barista recommendations:
• Heating: 3–6 minutes typical
• Extraction: 25–30 seconds
• Target output: 35–40g

No ads. No tracking. No accounts. No permissions beyond vibration.

summary.en-US: French daily word games — Le Mot, L'Hexagone, Connexions. Offline, no ads.

description.en-US:
Jeux du Jour is a collection of three French daily word games inspired by
the New York Times puzzle games. Every player gets the same puzzle on the
same day, generated deterministically from a date-based seed — no server
needed.

Le Mot (Wordle): Guess the 5-letter French word in 6 tries. Color-coded
feedback helps narrow down the answer.

L'Hexagone (Spelling Bee): Form as many words as possible using 7 letters
arranged in a hexagonal grid. Every word must include the center letter.
Climb from Débutant to Génie.

Connexions (Connections): Sort 16 words into four groups of four that share
a hidden connection. Four difficulty levels from yellow (easy) to purple
(tricky).

Dictionary powered by Lexique383 from lexique.org (109,000+ French words).
30 hand-curated Connexions puzzles included.

Free and open source. No ads. No tracking. No accounts. Works fully offline.

summary.en-US: Plays retreat recordings offline, with nothing able to interrupt them

description.en-US:
Retreat Player plays MP3s of dhamma talks, bells, and chanting during a
meditation retreat — built on the same principle as Retreat Timer: once
playback starts, nothing interrupts it.

* Every recording is downloaded into the app's own storage when it is loaded,
  so playback needs no network — airplane mode is fine.
* Playback runs in a foreground service holding a wake lock: the system
  cannot kill or pause it, even with the screen off for an hour-long talk.
* The screen stays on while a recording plays — no lock, no screensaver —
  showing the progress the whole time.
* A recording plays only because you pressed play, and only once: when it
  ends, nothing else starts automatically.

Loading and organising:

* Tap + to load recordings from the phone, from a shared WebDAV folder
  (e.g. Infomaniak kDrive), or from a podcast feed; folder and feed URLs are
  remembered for next time.
* Tiles are filed into two sections — Bells & chanting on top (used every
  day), then Dharma talks — and ordered by hand with arrows.
* The player shows elapsed and remaining time together, with play, pause,
  stop, 10-second jumps, and back-to-beginning.

No ads, no tracking, no accounts.

summary.en-US: Rings three meditation bells on schedule, even in deep sleep

description.en-US:
Retreat Timer rings a recording of three singing-bowl bells at the times of day
you choose — the signal to begin or end a sitting — so a meditation retreat
keeps running on schedule even when the teacher is not present.

Built for one job: the bells ring no matter what.

* Exact alarms via the same mechanism the stock Clock app uses, so they fire on
  time even when the device is locked, asleep, or in Doze for hours.
* A foreground service holds a wake lock and plays through the alarm stream, so
  the system cannot mute or kill the bells mid-ring.
* Alarms are re-armed automatically after a reboot, time change, or app update.
* A readiness light turns green once battery optimisation and notifications are
  set, so the teacher can leave knowing the schedule is safe.

Easy to set up:

* Tap + to add the next bell exactly one hour after the last (07:45 then 08:45).
* Tap any time to edit it; toggle bells on or off; delete with one tap.
* Per-bell and global Test buttons play the bells at the exact volume the room
  will hear, set with a slider.

No ads, no tracking, no accounts. The schedule repeats every day.

summary.en-US: 16 multiplayer games — play locally or online. No ads, no accounts.

description.en-US:
2P Games is a collection of 16 touch-friendly multiplayer games for two
players. Play locally on one device or online with a friend. No accounts,
no ads.

8 games support online play via room codes or quick match:
4 in a Row, Caro, Awalé, Memory, Duck-Day Chess, Tank Wars,
Word Clash, and Reversi.

Also includes Tennis (with power-ups), Pool, Carrom, Air Hockey,
Mini Golf, Star Clash, Hangman, and Horse Jump.

Each game has built-in instructions accessible via the ? button.

All games feature intuitive touch controls. Built-in calming background
music with toggle. Every game has rematch support.

Free and open source. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.

summary.en-US: E-ink friendly RSS/Atom reader for Android

description.en-US:
Lightweight RSS/Atom feed reader with a paginated reading mode
optimized for e-ink displays. Serif typography, adaptive font sizing,
tap zones for page turns. Bookmarks, OPML import/export, paid
Substack support via cookie authentication.
No accounts, no tracking — fully local and offline-capable.

summary.en-US: Classic artillery game rebuilt for mobile. 2-player local and online.

description.en-US:
Tank Wars Mobile is a faithful recreation of the classic DOS artillery game
Tank Wars 3.2 (1992) by Kenneth Morse, rebuilt from the ground up for mobile
touchscreens.

Two players take turns aiming their tanks and firing an arsenal of weapons at
each other across randomly generated destructible terrain. Judge the angle,
power, and wind to land your shots — there's no trajectory preview, so every
shot is a test of skill and intuition.

16 weapons including nukes, MIRVs, lasers, and chain reaction inducers.
3 defense systems: shields, inertia dampeners, and repulsers.
6 wall types, 5 wind levels, destructible terrain with crumbling.
Local 2-player hot-seat and online multiplayer via Firebase.

Free and open source. No ads. No tracking. No in-app purchases.

summary.en-US: E-ink optimized e-book reader and library browser

description.en-US:
Open-source e-book reader optimized for e-ink displays. Paginated
EPUB reading with adaptive font sizing, high-contrast themes, and
tap zones designed for e-paper. Search and download from online
library catalogs. Local library management.
This application is a reading tool. It does not host any content.
Users are solely responsible for compliance with copyright laws
in their jurisdiction.

summary.en-US: ePub reader tuned for daily newspaper / magazine issues

description.en-US:
Fork of Book's Story (ua.acclorite.book_story) with an opinionated
magazine-mode parser and TOC for ePub issues produced by the in-house
newsletter generator (NZZ, 24 heures, Courrier International, Economist
fixtures).

Detects magazine ePubs at open time, paginates the table of contents
with one card per article (category, title, optional cover image),
and routes tap → article view rendered by an in-zip WebView.

A permanent three-zone navigation header (prev / home / next) sits on
top of the existing tap-zone gesture system on every magazine screen.

Debug-signed; sideload only. Coexists with upstream Book's Story
release thanks to the .debug application id suffix.
